measurement.protocol: 5000 actual Spiral, 180 frames, three real Adds; identical production/fine flags before/after; no readback; all startup/peak frames retained; hidden WSI is not foreground certification

limitations: Hidden/unfocused WSI timing is not foreground FPS certification.
Compute-first is the requested architecture; the old native-first policy can be faster and use less memory.
GPU completion samples are delayed submission totals, not attribution to the current CPU frame.
Native exact pixel replay and RGBA8 alpha scratch remain; a pixel-local alpha accumulator is not implemented.
Frame timings exclude device/surface creation, prepared kernels and initial font loading; they are not cold executable launch timings.
Qualified deterministic cohorts disable the HUD. The normal changing FPS HUD can affect whole-program reuse; these are not normal foreground FPS certifications.
